messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Meloxicam can increase your risk of a fatal heart attack or stroke, especially if you use it long term or take high doses, or if you have heart disease. Even people without heart disease or risk factors could have a stroke or heart attack while taking this medicine.
Do not use this medicine just before or after heart bypass surgery (coronary artery bypass graft, or CABG).
Avoid taking meloxicam after a recent heart attack, unless your doctor tells you to. You may have an increased risk of another heart attack if you take this medicine after a recent heart attack.
Get emergency medical help if you have chest pain, weakness, shortness of breath, slurred speech, or problems with vision or balance.
Meloxicam may also cause stomach or intestinal bleeding, which can be fatal. These conditions can occur without warning while you are using this medicine, especially in older adults.
Call your doctor at once if you have symptoms of stomach bleeding, such as black, bloody, or tarry stools, or coughing up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds.
Avoid smoking and drinking alcohol, as they also increase your risk of stomach bleeding.
Triples: [["Meloxicam", "increases risk of", "fatal heart attack"], ["Meloxicam", "increases risk of", "stroke"], ["Meloxicam", "has risk factor", "long term use"], ["Meloxicam", "has risk factor", "high doses"], ["Meloxicam", "has risk factor", "heart disease"], ["Meloxicam", "has warning", "risk in people without heart disease or risk factors"], ["Meloxicam", "contraindicated in", "just before or after heart bypass surgery"], ["Meloxicam", "contraindicated in", "coronary artery bypass graft (CABG)"], ["Meloxicam", "should be avoided after", "recent heart attack"], ["Meloxicam", "increases risk of", "another heart attack after recent heart attack"], ["Meloxicam", "has emergency symptom", "chest pain"], ["Meloxicam", "has emergency symptom", "weakness"], ["Meloxicam", "has emergency symptom", "shortness of breath"], ["Meloxicam", "has emergency symptom", "slurred speech"], ["Meloxicam", "has emergency symptom", "problems with vision or balance"], ["Meloxicam", "has serious side effect", "stomach or intestinal bleeding"], ["Meloxicam", "has risk factor", "older adults"], ["Meloxicam", "has symptom of side effect", "black, bloody, or tarry stools"], ["Meloxicam", "has symptom of side effect", "coughing up blood"], ["Meloxicam", "has symptom of side effect", "vomit that looks like coffee grounds"], ["Meloxicam", "has administration instruction", "avoid smoking"], ["Meloxicam", "has administration instruction", "avoid drinking alcohol"], ["Meloxicam", "has risk factor", "smoking"], ["Meloxicam", "has risk factor", "drinking alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "has administration instruction", "has emergency symptom", "has risk factor", "has serious side effect", "has symptom of side effect", "has warning", "increases risk of", "should be avoided after"]
Answer:

completion:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used in the medical situation or procedure specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: Patients taking the subject drug should follow the specific instruction related to the object entity.  
has emergency symptom: An emergency medical situation may occur involving the symptom specified by the object entity while taking the subject drug.  
has risk factor: The subject drug poses an increased risk when associated with the factor specified by the object entity.  
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.  
has symptom of side effect: The subject drug may cause the specific symptom or manifestation of an adverse effect specified by the object entity.  
has warning: A specific caution or warning is associated with the subject drug related to the object entity.  
increases risk of: The subject drug increases the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.  
should be avoided after: The subject drug should not be taken after the event or condition specified by the object entity.
